sections.title: Bali to East Java — the route

blocks.body_md:
Every JVTO Bali package is 100% private — your group, your vehicle, your schedule. The Bali–Java ferry crossing (Gilimanuk–Ketapang) is included in every package. Mr. Sam, the founder, is an active officer of the Indonesian Tourist Police (Ditpamobvit East Java): every route, safety decision, and written rule traces back to someone who answers to police protocol.

Every Bali package crosses from Bali to East Java by ferry on Day 1. Most packages finish in Surabaya (one-way overland); the Bali-return option brings you back across the ferry. Pick-up is from your Bali hotel or address — Ubud, Seminyak, Canggu, or Lovina.

All packages include a dedicated vehicle, English-speaking crew, the Gilimanuk–Ketapang ferry, entrance fees, accommodation + breakfast, gas masks + trekking poles (Ijen), mineral water, and a JVTO T-shirt. Price is per person — no hidden local payments.

sections.title: Every Bali package includes — in writing

items.label: Bali–Java ferry crossing
items.detail: Gilimanuk–Ketapang, both directions on the Bali-return package, one-way Bali-to-Java on the others.

items.label: Private transport
items.detail: AC MPV (1–3 guests) or Toyota Hiace (4–9 guests). Fuel, tolls, and parking included.

items.label: Dedicated crew
items.detail: English-speaking driver-guide (1–3 guests), or professional driver + escort guide (4+). Licensed local site guides at key locations.

items.label: Entrance fees, permits & accommodation
items.detail: Entrance fees, permits, and accommodation + breakfast on all nights, per itinerary.

items.label: Private 4WD jeep
items.detail: Bromo crater area. One jeep per ≤4 guests; additional jeeps for larger groups.

items.label: Gas masks & trekking poles
items.detail: For the Ijen crater hike, plus mandatory health-certificate screening coordination for every guest before crater entry.

items.label: Daily mineral water & pick-up
items.detail: Full pick-up to drop-off from your Bali hotel, and a JVTO travel T-shirt (one per participant).

items.body: Most Bali packages finish in Surabaya — plan your onward transport from Surabaya (flights, train, or bus) in advance. Only the Bali-return option brings you back across the ferry; each package page states its end point.
Ferry crossing, entrance fees, accommodation, gas masks, and all transport costs are bundled and confirmed in your voucher — no mid-trip negotiations.

items.title: Police-Led Operations
items.body: Mr. Sam holds the rank of Bripka — active officer of Ditpamobvit East Java (Tourist Police). Confirmed by Detik.com, 2021. No other East Java operator is led by a serving Tourist Police officer.

items.title: 100% Private — No Shared Groups
items.body: Your booking receives a dedicated vehicle and crew. No join-in option exists. Group size determines vehicle type; timing and route decisions apply to your group only.

items.title: All-Inclusive — Written Before You Book
items.body: Ferry crossing, entrance fees, accommodation, gas masks, and all transport costs are bundled and confirmed in your voucher. The voucher is the booking reference — no mid-trip negotiations over ticket costs, fuel, or meals.

items.title: Verifiable Credentials
items.body: NIB 1102230032918 verifiable via OSS. HPWKI AHU-0001072.AH.01.07.TAHUN 2024. BBKSDA clearance and POLPAR authorisation on file, and Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu holds a valid SIP license (Kemenkes/KKI verifiable).
